# Jay Beniza

> UI/UX and product designer based in the Philippines, with nearly 4 years of experience designing 24 web and mobile products, most for education, government, and public sector clients. Builds Figma design systems and AI-assisted front-ends with Claude Code.

This is Jay Beniza's portfolio. It shows case studies of selected work, an archive of earlier explorations, an about page with experience and skills, and a project request form for clients.

## Pages

- [Home](https://jaybeniza.vercel.app/): introduction, featured work, areas of expertise, process, and testimonials
- [Work](https://jaybeniza.vercel.app/work): all case studies
- [Archive](https://jaybeniza.vercel.app/archive): earlier projects and design explorations
- [About](https://jaybeniza.vercel.app/about): background, work experience, skills, certificates and awards
- [Get in Touch](https://jaybeniza.vercel.app/get-in-touch): project request form

- UI/UX and product design for web and mobile
- Design systems and UI kits in Figma
- Prototyping and usability testing
- Working front-ends built with Claude Code
